title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Optional Equipment Price List
content:
Four items of optional equipment are sold on the Car Rental Rate Classes. Satellite navigation and child seats are priced for each rental day; snow chains and ski racks are priced for the whole rental.

| Rate class | Satellite navigation per day (USD) | Child seat per day (USD) | Snow chains per rental (USD) | Ski rack per rental (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 13.99 | 14.99 | 45.00 | 55.00 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 12.99 | 13.99 | 42.00 | 52.00 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 11.99 | 12.99 | 39.00 | 49.00 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 9.99 | 10.99 | 35.00 | 42.00 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 8.99 | 9.99 | 32.00 | 39.00 |

The child seat amount is charged for each seat. The two per-rental items are charged once for the whole rental however long it runs.

**Worked illustration on hypothetical inputs.** Take a hypothetical hire of four days on the Pay At Counter Flex Rate carrying one satellite navigation unit, two child seats and a ski rack. The navigation unit is four days at 11.99, the two seats are two seats over four days at 12.99 for each seat for each day, and the ski rack is one amount of 49 for the whole rental. On the Premium Inclusive Rate the same four items are all published at 0, because that class carries them in the rate.
